## Download

**[KitelabDB.dmg](https://github.com/kitelab-dev/kitedb/releases/latest/download/KitelabDB.dmg)** — Apple Silicon (M1 or newer), macOS 14 Sonoma or later.

## Install

1. Open the `.dmg` and drag **Kitelab DB** into **Applications**.
2. The app is not notarized by Apple yet, so the first launch is blocked. Either:
   - open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway** next to “Kitelab DB”, or
   - run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Kitelab DB.app"` in Terminal.

## Суулгах

1. `.dmg` файлыг нээгээд **Kitelab DB**-г **Applications** руу чирнэ.
2. Апп Apple-аар notarize хийгдээгүй тул анх нээхэд блоклогдоно. **System Settings → Privacy & Security** хэсэгт **Open Anyway** дарна, эсвэл Terminal дээр `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Kitelab DB.app"` ажиллуулна.
